validity.recommendation: Leave Diameter blank on P6712 -- do not carry across the wiki's 1,067 mm figure. 'III (Capacity expansion)' is the SECOND STAGE of the already-laid Phase II ('second thread'/second line) pipeline: it raises that same pipe's own throughput from 10 to 15 bcm/y (10 + 5 = 15, matching P6712's own Capacity = 5.00 exactly), not a new trunk line with a diameter of its own. This is consistent with the sheet's own LengthKnownKm = 0.00 and RouteAccuracy = 'no route' on this row, which already treat it as a no-new-pipe capacity increment -- the same pattern Phase I itself followed when it went from an initial lower capacity to 15 bcm/y purely by adding compressor stations (Bozoy, Karaozek, Aral, Korkyt Ata, Turkestan, Ustyurt/KS-1A), with no change to the original single pipe's diameter.
validity.researcher_notes: A 2025-09-12 Kursiv Media article (kz.kursiv.media) on UCC Holding's plans for the BBS second thread states its capacity target explicitly in two phases: 'На первом этапе планируется обеспечить мощность второй нитки в 10 млрд кубометров в год, на втором -- довести ее до 15 млрд кубометров' (Phase 1: 10 bcm/y; Phase 2: 15 bcm/y total) -- an exact match to P5788 (Capacity 10.00, construction, StartYear1 2026) feeding into P6712 (Capacity 5.00, proposed, StartYear1 2029; construction window given as September 2025-February 2029, matching P6712's 2029 StartYear1). The article also describes the TWO options under consideration for reaching that second-phase capacity: (1) new dedicated compressor stations built specifically for the second thread, or (2) expanding the FIRST thread's existing compressor stations and connecting them to the second thread via short tie-in pipes, for a combined system of 30 bcm/y -- neither option is a new long-distance trunk pipeline segment with its own diameter spec; both are compression-side work (the article does not say which option was ultimately chosen). This is corroborated by the broader QazaqGaz-UCC Holding program description (epcintel.com), whose only NEW-pipe figure ('1,600 km of new pipeline and six compressor stations') is explicitly the combined scope of multiple projects (BBS second line construction itself, the new KS-14-Kostanay-Aktobe line, and Kashagan gas-processing infrastructure) -- i.e. that new-pipe mileage belongs to P5788's own construction, not to a further P6712 increment. Tier is medium-high: the Kursiv figures line up exactly with both P5788 and P6712's sheet values (strong internal consistency, not just external agreement), but I did not find a second, fully independent source stating explicitly 'Phase 2/III adds no new pipe' in so many words -- that specific inference is mine, drawn from the two-option compressor-station framing plus the LengthKnownKm=0 pattern Phase I already set.
